predecessor.reason_for_consumed_mechanism_only: The next source with multiple explicit from-left power-strip tasks, visit 422200, had opaque target IDs displayed before this protocol was frozen. It may test mechanics but cannot support a fresh claim.

source.dataset: SceneFun3D train split plus ARKitScenes low-resolution ARKit camera trajectory
source.camera_pose_frame: ARKit camera-to-world after official trajectory inversion

selection.ordering: ascending visit_id then video_id from the official one-video CSV
selection.stop_rule: Stop immediately after the first self-carrier active-view opportunity.

frozen_algorithm.view_selection: Among real trajectory poses that contain every lattice candidate inside the frozen normalized frustum, maximize horizontal span, then minimize median depth, then choose earliest timestamp.
frozen_algorithm.left_right_authority: Camera-frame projected x coordinate from the selected real pose; smaller x is left.
frozen_algorithm.baseline: All candidates in the admitted local same-action lattice remain set-valued.

forbidden_after_source_access: read description annot_id values during provider construction
change lattice, view, or ranking thresholds
choose candidates or poses using evaluator outcomes
claim_boundary: Target-exposed consumed-mechanism source admission for a self-carrier functional lattice plus real active view. A positive result may establish mechanics only, never fresh transfer, RGB proposal quality, online view reachability, tracking, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, or safety.
